proposedContracts.name: matches native framecrc across sources, channel counts, rates, tap lists and s16/f32/f64 outputs
proposedContracts.scope: linux/x64: framecrc of u8/s16/s32/f32/f64 sources, mono/stereo, 8000/44100 Hz, nine option sets (1-3 taps, short/long/>2048-sample/zero-sample taps, saturation, named/duplicated options, default), source codec plus s16/f32/f64 outputs

proposedContracts.name: matches native on long multi-frame inputs, where the tail only follows the last input frame
proposedContracts.scope: linux/x64: 24000-sample stereo s16/f32/f64 at 8000/44100 Hz; tail packet total equals max_samples after all input

proposedContracts.name: matches native composed chains, output -t/-ss/-to/-frames:a and input time selection over the tail
proposedContracts.scope: linux/x64: aecho with asetnsamples, apad, volume and anull neighbours under output -t/-ss/-to/-frames:a and input -ss/-t, s16/f64 mono/stereo at 8000 Hz

proposedContracts.name: matches native output for configured empty input, where only the silent tail remains
proposedContracts.scope: linux/x64: empty u8/s16/f32 stereo raw input, aecho alone and with asetnsamples, output -t/-ss/-frames:a

proposedContracts.name: writes native-identical WAV and raw PCM files from WAV and raw inputs
proposedContracts.scope: linux/x64: WAV and raw outputs from raw and WAV inputs in all five PCM formats, one two-tap option set

proposedContracts.name: fails explicitly before output where native fails, and for accepted forms that remain unimplemented
proposedContracts.scope: Native exit status for 23 option forms (14 native errors, 9 natively accepted but unimplemented), zero max_samples and rate conversion; no output file created

proposedContracts.name: refuses a delay ring above the buffer budget before opening output
proposedContracts.scope: PCM plan refuses a ring above maxBufferBytes with resource-budget before output

proposedContracts.name: parses defaults, positional and named options, empty list fields and float32 values
proposedContracts.scope: aecho option syntax, defaults, last-wins and empty-field skipping

proposedContracts.name: refuses native errors and unimplemented option forms with exact messages
proposedContracts.scope: Exact refusal messages for native errors and unimplemented forms

proposedContracts.name: computes tap indexes in float32 truncated toward zero, and refuses a rate where nothing echoes
proposedContracts.scope: config_output tap sample math and the max_samples constraint

proposedContracts.name: negotiates the native picks, refuses rate conversion and declares its tail and ring
proposedContracts.scope: Native format picks, capability flags, count/packetSections/plannedReservations for the tail and ring

proposedContracts.name: matches a transcription of the C loop for every working format, frame split and tap list, with owned outputs and the tail after the last frame
proposedContracts.scope: echo_samples_<fmt>p transcription across s16p/s32p/fltp/dblp, packed/planar, frame splits; ownership and tail timestamps

proposedContracts.name: widens u8 to s16p, emits the configured empty-input tail and enforces allocation, format and cancellation limits
proposedContracts.scope: u8 widening, configured empty input, allocation/format/timestamp limits and AbortSignal

notes: No shared edit beyond the registry line was needed.
Per spec registry notes: formats() is the native array; no negotiate/nativeFormats/flacInput declared.
Byte-exact differential tests are gated to linux/x64 (float/double arithmetic, FMA-sensitive on macOS arm64 per wave-select notes); refusal and budget tests run everywhere.
Native accepts unscannable list tokens (e.g. 'abc') by skipping them; this implementation refuses them explicitly.
Setup durations: submodule init 49s; npm ci + reference:build 3m39s; baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries 1m27s; baseline unit suite 1m37s; aecho differential suite ~26s.
Environment: FLAC codec artifacts unavailable (downloads.xiph.org blocked), as expected; no other problems.
